description.value:
Frequency once per day

Range touch

Targets 1 willing ally

Duration 10 minutes

You share what Low Passage gave you. For the duration, the target can see and briefly speak with the recently dead in its presence exactly as you can, and Embers it holds glow faintly warm to the touch. It does not gain any other benefit of your Passage, and it does not accrue Passage of its own — this is borrowed, and it is the only thing being lent.

cinderfall.incomplete: This grants an ally a temporary sense/capability or lets an ally use the caster's own reaction with the caster's own modifiers, sourced from the caster's own class feature. No selector or rule element exists anywhere in pf2e-source for granting an ally a buff/sense/action from this actor's own item or ability -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass, and even more specific here (lending an action with the lender's own modifiers is a step beyond the already-confirmed absence). "Low Passage" itself is also unmodeled (see the base-resource note), so there is nothing to copy from even if the mechanism existed.
